# Vaidyabandhu - Bangalore's Verified Medical Directory

> A high-authority platform connecting patients with verified Ayurvedic doctors, clinics, and hospitals in Bangalore, India. Every listed practitioner is verified with medical registration credentials to ensure trust and safety.

## Core Services
- [Doctor Search](https://www.vaidyabandhu.com/doctor-list): Comprehensive directory of verified medical specialists in Bangalore.
- [Doctor Grid View](https://www.vaidyabandhu.com/doctor-grid): Browse doctors in a visual grid layout.
- [Clinic Booking](https://www.vaidyabandhu.com/clinic-list): Top-rated wellness centers and clinics with appointment booking.
- [Hospital Directory](https://www.vaidyabandhu.com/hospital-list): Verified hospitals in Bangalore and across India.
- [Appointment Booking](https://www.vaidyabandhu.com/appointment): Book appointments with verified doctors online.
- [Verified Profiles](https://www.vaidyabandhu.com/about): Our doctor verification protocol ensuring E-E-A-T compliance.

## Trust & Verification
- All doctors verified with official medical registration numbers
- Patient trust scores based on verified reviews
- E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) compliant profiles
- NABH-accredited hospital partnerships
